SEPTEMBER 7-13, 2026

Learn From the Gibeonites

SONG 88 Make Me Know Your Ways

“The inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and remained among them.”​—JOSH. 10:1.

FOCUS

Identify lessons we can learn from the Gibeonites.

1-2. Why should we be interested in what the Bible says about the Gibeonites? (Josh. 9:3)

THE year is 1473 B.C.E. The nation of Israel has begun its conquest. They knew that he had promised to drive the Canaanites out of the land, (Ex. 34:11; Josh. 9:24) so they sought peace. Like the apostle Paul wrote, 2 Ki. 5:14, we should have faith.

3. (a) Who were the Gibeonites? (b) Why did they seek peace?

3 When the Israelites began their conquest, (Read Deuteronomy 7:1) they obeyed God.

SONG 143 Keep Working, Watching, and Waiting
